tokens.name: layout.primary

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts or exact type values are stored.
tokens.role: Humanist sans type keeps instructions and repeated controls approachable without softening their meaning. Curved boundaries and edge behavior influence content placement.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: The role is analytical; preview colors are original study values.
tokens.role: Tasks minimize steps, text entry, and sustained attention.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: Low-power and inactive states preserve essential information without full intensity.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Round glanceable display with one metric, one status, and one reachable action. Icons identify action or state and never carry meaning alone.
